declared_intent: Plan and perform tenant-scoped Microsoft 365 actions with dry-run defaults and explicit approval gates.

allowed_by_default: Read user-provided tenant context and requested admin scope.
Generate PowerShell/Graph plans and dry-run scripts.
Write local admin plans, manifests, and rollback notes.
confirmation_required: Any Graph, PowerShell, or tenant write action.
User, group, policy, license, or security setting changes.
Using admin credentials or connector sessions.
denied_by_default: Executing production changes without dry-run and approval.

token_optimization: Move PowerShell templates and troubleshooting into references/scripts.
selection_precision: Rank for explicit M365 tenant administration, not generic cloud or compliance tasks.
review_status: preview-only; user should review before installation
